question: Should OpenClaw add dynamic ack reaction selection, and if so should the first supported shape be a configured selector/array or model-driven contextual choice?
rationale: This adds a new cross-channel config/API behavior with compatibility, latency, and transport-specific emoji semantics that code inspection alone cannot choose.

options.title: Add configured selector first
options.body: Keep `ackReaction` as the backward-compatible single value and add an explicit array or deterministic strategy contract that channels can validate consistently.

options.title: Design model-driven pre-ack selection
options.body: Add a model/context hook only if maintainers accept the extra pre-processing latency and decide what message context is safe to expose before acknowledgement.

options.title: Do not add core selector
options.body: Keep one configured ack reaction and route naturalness experiments through manual message-tool reactions or channel/plugin-specific proposals.

recommendation.title: Add configured selector first
recommendation.body: Keep `ackReaction` as the backward-compatible single value and add an explicit array or deterministic strategy contract that channels can validate consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent per-channel ackReaction contract that this product/API decision would extend.
